codes.CN_EXCEEDS_INVOICE: Credit notes cannot add up to more than the invoice. Lower the amounts, or credit what is still left.
codes.CN_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft credit note can be edited or deleted. Reload to see its current state.
codes.CN_ALREADY_VOID: This credit note is already void.
codes.CN_HAS_REFUND: Cash was returned for this credit note, so it cannot be voided. The refund stays in the payment ledger.
codes.CN_NOTHING_TO_CREDIT: There is nothing left to credit here. Choose a line with something remaining, or add an amount.
codes.CN_LINE_INVALID: A credited line is not valid: the quantity is more than what is left, or an amount is wrong. Check the highlighted lines.
codes.INV_NOT_ISSUED: A credit note can only be made against an issued invoice.

list.title: Credit notes
list.subtitle: Documents that reduce what a buyer owes on an issued invoice.
list.noAccess: You do not have permission to see credit notes.
list.emptyFiltered: Try a different search or clear the filters.

all.title: No credit notes yet
all.message: Credit an issued invoice when goods come back, a price was wrong or you want to give something back.

draft.title: No drafts
draft.message: Credit notes you are still preparing show up here.

issued.title: Nothing issued
issued.message: Issued credit notes have a number and have already changed their invoice.

void.title: Nothing voided
void.message: Credit notes that were voided are kept here.

list.showing: {count, plural, one {# credit note} other {# credit notes}} loaded
list.clearInvoice: Show credit notes of every invoice

issue.title: Issue this credit note?
issue.message: It takes its number and lowers what the buyer owes on the invoice. With a cash refund, money is returned through the payment ledger. After that it can no longer be edited.

void.title: Void this credit note?
void.warning: The credit stops counting: the invoice goes back to what it was before this credit note.
void.reasonHint: Required. It is kept on the credit note.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.message: The draft is removed for good. Nothing has been issued, so the invoice does not change.

picker.search: Search issued invoices by number or buyer
picker.notCreditable: A credit note can only be made against an issued invoice (issued, partly paid, overdue or paid). Pick another invoice.

lines.freeHint: A goodwill amount or an adjustment that is not tied to a line. The amount is before tax.

problems.nothing: Choose something to credit: a line, or a free-form amount.
problems.qtyInvalid: Enter a quantity above 0, with at most 4 decimals.
problems.qtyExceeds: At most {max} can still be credited on this line.
problems.noteTooLong: The note is longer than 2000 characters.

estimate.title: Estimated credit
estimate.disclaimer: An estimate worked out here with the invoice prices and tax. The figures the server saves are the final ones.
estimate.empty: Nothing to credit yet. Choose the whole invoice, or tick lines.
estimate.exceeds: This is more than the invoice still allows to be credited ({max}). The server will refuse it.
estimate.refundNote: Cash refund: money the buyer has paid above what is still owed is returned through the payment ledger when you issue it.
estimate.balanceNote: Applied to balance: no money is paid out. The credit only lowers what the buyer owes.

builder.noAccess: You do not have permission to create credit notes.
builder.notDraft: Only a draft credit note can be edited.
builder.conflict: Someone else changed this credit note while you were editing it. Reload to see the latest version; your changes here will be lost.

invoice.title: Invoice to credit
invoice.hint: A credit note belongs to one issued invoice.

details.title: Details
details.issueDateHint: Leave it empty to use the day you issue it (today is {today}).
details.noteHint: Printed on the credit note. Optional.

settlement.title: What happens to the money
settlement.hint: Chosen now, applied when the credit note is issued.

balance.title: Apply to the invoice balance
balance.body: The invoice owes less. No money moves. Use it when the buyer has not paid yet, or will keep the credit.

refund.title: Refund in cash
refund.body: Whatever the buyer has already paid above what is now owed is returned through the payment ledger as a refund.

what.title: What to credit
what.loadingCredits: Checking earlier credit notes of this invoice

full.title: The whole remaining invoice
full.body: Credits every line, and the shipping with the first credit note. Still creditable:

lines.title: Some lines or amounts
lines.body: Tick the lines and quantities to credit, or add a free-form amount.

builder.estimateWaiting: Pick an invoice to see the estimated credit.
builder.savedToast: Credit note saved as a draft.
builder.savedNotIssued: Saved as a draft, but it could not be issued: {reason}

detail.noAccess: You do not have permission to see credit notes.
detail.cannotVoidRefunded: Cash was returned for this credit note, so it cannot be voided. The refund stays in the payment ledger.

money.title: What happened to the money
money.titleDraft: What will happen to the money
money.voidNote: This credit note was voided, so it no longer reduces the invoice.
money.draftNote: If you issue it as it is now:
money.estimate: An estimate until it is issued.
money.balanceBody: Settlement: applied to the balance. No money is paid out.
money.refundBody: Settlement: cash refund. Money paid above what is still owed goes back to the buyer through the payment ledger.

after.title: The invoice after this credit note
